title: PbfuzzStateBlocks
description: The analysis blocks `pbfuzz_plan` writes during PIER, one JSON file per block under `.pbfuzz/<id>/state/`. The tool validates its input against the matching $def before writing, and `PbfuzzHost.advancePhase()` refuses a phase transition whose required blocks are missing or incomplete; a direct agent `write`/`edit` of these files is denied. Ported from the CCS'26 pydantic schemas, with the vulnerability category opened up so the framework is not C/C++-specific.

BugPredicate.description: One disjunctive branch of the triggering condition — satisfying ANY BugPredicate triggers the bug. `bug_predicates.json` holds an array of these.

bug_condition.description: The condition extracted from the target source line.

Precondition.description: A condition that must hold to REACH the target. `preconditions.json` holds an array.

input_constraints.description: Non-semantic constraints as math expressions (`width < 100`); semantic ones in natural language.

RootCause.description: Why the bug triggers once reached. `root_causes.json` holds an array.

category.description: Vulnerability category. The listed values are suggestions spanning memory-unsafe and memory-safe languages; any other string is accepted so the framework stays language-agnostic.

TriggerPlan.description: A high-level route to the bug, with a self-assessed implementation cost. The agent works the lowest-complexity pending plan first. `trigger_plans.json` holds an array.

BatchPlanEntry.description: One concrete parameter assignment to try in stage 1, before the sampler takes over. `plan_description` is reserved; every other key is a generator parameter and must exist in the parameter space with a value inside its domain.

FuzzPlan.description: `fuzz_plan.json` — what EXECUTE runs. The parameter space defines the generator's keyword arguments; the batch plan pins the first concrete cases; breakpoints are traced during stage 1.

generator_path.description: The generator module written in IMPLEMENT, exposing `generate(**params) -> bytes`.
